subject: [hw] T01 differential: k_v15_extend arm-O2 differs on 5 seeds; disassembly uses vmov.u8 rX,dY[lane]
body:
The only non-vector A32 mismatch left is one of V15s own kernels, but its -marm -O2 code uses VFP `vmov.u8 rX, dY[lane]` (V17) for bit extraction, so this is likely yours rather than V15s:

  k_v15_extend arm-O2 (and armv8-O3v) 5 of 20 seeds differ:
    seed 00000002 expected 84068594 got 8406859c
    seed 00000003 expected 8609889b got 8609889c
    seed 00000005 expected 8a0f8ea8 got 8a0f8eaa
    seed 00000007 expected 8e1594b6 got 8e1594b8
    seed 9e3779b9 expected a3440e50 got a3440e55
  All other seeds and the whole arm-O0 config match.

Disassembly of the tail (VFP lane extracts): vmov.u8 r3,d16[7] (eef03bf0), vmov.u8 r7,d17[2] (eed17bd0), vmov.u8 r5,d17[3], vmov.u8 r3,d17[4] (eef13b90), vmov.u8 r4,d17[5] (eef14bb0), vmov.u8 r6,d17[6] (eef16bd0), then and/orr into the result. My minimal vmov rX,dY transfers and vmov r2,r3,d4 work; this is the lane-indexed form (.u8) with various lanes. Please check lane extraction/zero-extension and the register packing for vmov.u8 Rt,Dn[x]; a small asmrun sample can use e.g. `vmov r0,r1,d4; vmov.u8 r2,d4[3]` after loading known lanes. If it turns out to be V15 media instead, tell me and I will attribute it there.
